# Session Handoff Template

**Location:** `docs/templates/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`
**Governed by:** §11.4.8, §10.9.9

## Purpose

Standardized format for session handoff records, ensuring development can continue consistently between sessions (§10.9.9, §11.6.6).

## Instructions

- Do not rely solely on conversational history for important decisions or project state (§10.9.9).
- Distinguish verified facts from reasonable assumptions from unresolved questions (§10.9.9).
- Keep progress reports consistent with the Master Development Roadmap (§10.9.9).

## Template

```
# HANDOFF-YYYY-MM-DD — [Session Summary]

**Record ID:** HANDOFF-YYYY-MM-DD
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Session:** [Session identifier or description]

## Work Completed

Summarize what was completed during this session. Distinguish completed, incomplete, tested, and unverified work (§10.9.3).

## Incomplete Tasks

What tasks were started but not completed?

## Outstanding Issues and Blockers

What issues or blockers prevent progress? Classify per §10.9.8 (temporary / significant / fundamental).

## Deferred or Paused Work

What work has been deferred, paused, or requires approval?

## Recommended Next Steps

What should be the next development task? Reference the Master Development Roadmap.

## User Feedback, Requirements, and Consequential Decisions

Record any user feedback, requirements changes, or consequential decisions made during this session.

## Approvals and Conditions

Record any important approvals and conditions attached to them (§10.9.5).

## Documentation and Records Needed to Resume

List documents and records needed to resume work in the next session (§10.9.9).

## Assumptions and Uncertainty

Distinguish:
- Verified facts: [List]
- Reasonable assumptions: [List]
- Unresolved questions: [List]
```
